title: Investigate the complete execution environment
text: The Diginomica note separates instructions, memory, execution environment, connections and the operating loop. A failed answer or action may originate in any of these components. This gives a more useful debugging structure than replacing the model before checking whether it received the right information and tools.
qualification: Article represented in analytical notes. The title’s strong model-versus-harness ranking is not accepted as a universal empirical result.
